summary: SK Telecom filed a 6-K attaching a summary English translation of its Korean semiannual business report covering January 1 to June 30, 2026, equivalent to a US Form 10-Q disclosure. The filing solely reports that the company had 18 consolidated subsidiaries at period end, down from 19 after the liquidation of unlisted Global AI Platform Corporation Korea Co., Ltd., with no remaining listed subsidiary. No stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or deal terms are disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report; the subsidiary wind-down is an ordinary corporate housekeeping event rather than a special situation, so there is no risk-arb angle.
